primary_content.text: Inspired by the great Aussie outdoors, Outdoor TV Australia was born from a simple idea: to bring entertainment beyond the living room. We design and curate weatherproof TVs built to thrive under Australia’s harshest conditions, from blazing summers to stormy nights.
Proudly Australian owned, our mission is to make every backyard, patio, and open space the perfect place to gather, relax, and enjoy moments that last - rain, shine, or anything in between.

primary_content.text: See how our outdoor TVs bring bright, waterproof entertainment to Australia’s favourite events, from backyard parties to the Australian Open.

main_topic.h_title: Am I Sacrificing Quality for an Outdoor TV?
main_topic.main_title: Outdoor TV Australia, Waterproof Anti-Glare Outdoor Televisions

primary_content.text: All our Spark TVs boast 4K LED/QLED capabilities, delivering incredibly sharp and vibrant images.

With high brightness levels and an advanced cooling system, it performs flawlessly no matter the conditions. All Spark TVs include multiple HDMI ports, Wi-Fi connectivity & Smart TV operating systems, which make connecting all your devices a breeze! Plus, access the App Store to make sure you can download all your favourite apps.

main_topic.main_title: Outdoor TV Australia, Waterproof Anti-Glare Outdoor Televisions

primary_content.text: Spark TVs are crafted to be tough and durable, ready to face whatever mother nature throws at them.
All Spark TVs are built to IP55 standard, which in plain terms means they are designed to be outside and endure rain, a spray from the hose, dust, and even extreme temperature changes.

The Outdoor TV range is packed full of features to keep them working year round including in built cooling fans and corrosion-resistant and heatproof metal casing, allowing the TVs to withstand harsh weather conditions up to 65 degrees.

main_topic.main_title: Outdoor TV Australia, Waterproof Anti-Glare Outdoor Televisions

primary_content.text: When you're talking about outdoor TVs, you'll often hear about "NITS." NITS are a way of measuring how bright the screen gets. The higher the number of nits, the brighter the TV and therefore the clearer the picture in bright conditions.

Whilst indoor TVs average around 300 NITS, our Spark range starts at 5x that brightness starting at 1500 NITS. Our range has models for every scenario and venue, going all the way up to the brightest TV on the market – The Spark Lumin at 4000 NITS which is 13x brighter than an indoor TV.
